content_fields.title: Test prevention against input file attacks (Bash/Shell)
content_fields.description: Test that the script refuses to run when a required input file is missing or not a regular file.
content_fields.finding: Input files consumed by the script are not validated before execution.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/tests/security/test_ops_scripts.sh
set -euo pipefail

mv start_app.sh start_app.sh.bak
if ./start_game.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "FAIL: start_game.sh ran with a missing dependency" >&2
    mv start_app.sh.bak start_app.sh
    exit 1
fi
mv start_app.sh.bak start_app.sh
criteria: A test removes a required input and asserts the script exits non-zero.
The failure message names the missing file.
